scope: Missing-hours research only; do not publish without dated source evidence

records.name: Lalla Grill Del Monte
records.verifiedHours: Mon–Thu 11 AM–9 PM; Fri–Sat 11 AM–10 PM; Sun 10 AM–9 PM
records.notes: Official location page at 1400 Del Monte Center. Already published by PR #17.

records.name: Pizza My Heart (Del Monte Center)
records.notes: Official Pizza My Heart Monterey location at 660 Del Monte Center. Already published on main.

records.name: Poke House (Del Monte Center)
records.notes: Official location at 515 Del Monte Center distinguishes store hours from its 7:45 PM online cutoff. Restaurantji and Birdeye confirm store hours. A Squarespace regional site lists 9 PM closing, and an Ordersave ordering page lists 10 AM opening. The current canonical location page and corroborating storefront listings agree.

records.name: Starbucks (Del Monte Center)
records.notes: Call (831) 642-0736. Mall tenant page confirms this cafe and phone but publishes no weekly hours. Waze gives daily 6 AM–7 PM at 492 Del Monte Center. The existing research listing reported 5 AM–9/9:30 PM. The store locator for this cafe is 18425 and supplies no readable hours. Store 66442 is downtown.

records.name: California Pizza Kitchen (Del Monte Center)
records.verifiedHours: Sun–Thu 11 AM–9 PM; Fri–Sat 11 AM–10 PM
records.notes: Restaurantji and Carmel.com publish identical full dining hours at 1100 Del Monte Center. Mall and tourism listings confirm the address and phone but omit schedules. The prior research note mentions shorter hotel-directory hours without identifying a source. The named location-specific listings agree.

records.name: Chopstix Vietnamese Restaurant
records.notes: Restaurantji and MenuToEat both publish the full weekly restaurant schedule at 1244 Munras Ave. Tourism directory confirms the address and phone. The restaurant website displays the menu without hours.

records.name: Krua Thai Restaurant
records.verifiedHours: Mon 4–8 PM; Tue–Fri 11 AM–2:30 PM and 4:30–8 PM; Sat noon–2:30 PM and 4:30–8 PM; Sun closed
records.notes: Official contact schedule at 731 Munras Avenue explicitly lists Monday hours. Footer omits Monday. Tripadvisor independently confirms Monday 4–8 PM. The website lists a break between lunch and dinner Tuesday through Saturday.

records.name: The Wild Plum Cafe
records.notes: Official downtown location at 731 Munras Ave, Suite B, lists daily hours with an explicit Tuesday closure. Ryan Ranch is a separate location.

records.name: Rice and Roots
records.notes: Official website lists new hours with Wednesday closed. The older downtown association opening announcement says daily. The newer first-party schedule supersedes it.

records.name: Scoops Ice Cream Parlor
records.notes: Call (831) 521-1339. Downtown association confirms Suite 103 at 595 Munras Ave but lists only a one-time grand opening. Roadtrippers lists Mon–Thu 1–10 PM, Fri 1–11 PM, Sat noon–11 PM, Sun noon–10 PM. MenuPix has a substantially different schedule. Confirm current hours with the shop.

records.name: Carmel Bakery and Coffee House
records.notes: Official bakery location page confirms the Monterey shop at 220 Alvarado St, Suite 220. Its weekly retail hours are separate from the special Paseo Night Market listing.

records.name: Indian Summer Hookah Lounge, Bar & Grill
records.verifiedHours: Lounge hours: Mon 7 PM–midnight; Tue–Thu and Sun 5 PM–midnight; Fri–Sat 5 PM–2 AM next day. Kitchen hours unconfirmed.
records.notes: Official venue hours at 220 Olivier Street. The published schedule applies to the hookah lounge and cocktail bar. Separate kitchen hours are unavailable and should be confirmed with the venue.

records.name: Puma Road at Portola Plaza
records.notes: Chamber member listing at 281 Alvarado Street identifies these as tasting room hours. The winery’s pickup schedule for that tasting room matches.

records.name: Benny Walker's
records.notes: Soft-opening hours reported as daily 4–8 PM at 444 Alvarado St, with longer 11 AM–10:30 PM hours possible as soon as Nov 11. Downtown association lists the venue but no standing schedule. Confirm the post-soft-opening schedule with the operator.

records.name: Compact Disco — EAT takeout window
records.verifiedHours: Takeout window Fri–Sat 10 PM–2 AM next day
records.notes: Edible Monterey Bay’s June 30, 2026 report gives the opening and closing times of the walk-up EAT window. Compact Disco’s June 8, 2026 announcement confirms the Friday and Saturday 2 AM close for the outdoor EAT window at 420 Tyler Street. The current downtown association listing confirms the window is still at that address. Club and happy-hour hours are separate.

records.name: Pretzelmaker
records.notes: Call (831) 521-6001. Official tenant page confirms the location but has no weekly hours. Restaurantji and Yellow Pages list Mon–Fri 11 AM–8 PM, Sat 11 AM–7 PM, Sun 11 AM–5 PM. USA Restaurants lists Friday until 9 PM with a different phone number. Confirm the tenant’s Friday closing time and weekly schedule.

records.name: Whole Foods Market — Prepared Foods
records.notes: Call (831) 333-1600 for the Prepared Foods counter and hot bar. The location page confirms the hot bar but publishes only supermarket hours. Counter service may run on a different schedule.

records.name: Starbucks Coffee — Downtown Alvarado
records.notes: Yellow Pages, Restaurantji and EatOutMap agree on the weekly cafe schedule at 316 Alvarado St. Cylex agrees except for a dated Saturday holiday exception. A SuperPages search summary shows Sunday at 4 AM but the associated location-specific listing matches the 4:30 AM opening. Starbucks official locator does not expose a readable schedule.
